evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 202 and no payload bytes.
LocalLab runtime evidence captured opcode 202 after an idle period as the single unknown packet that paused framing; the packet has fixed length 0 and arrives specifically after inactivity.

The recovered protocol authority identifies client opcode 202 as the zero-payload idle-logout notification. Adding fixed-0 framing for this opcode resolved the half-responsive movement freeze without altering other packet parsing.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 fixed-0 idle logout packet. This is distinct from any explicit user logout route, which is not asserted here.
